//: Shared TypeScript base for every app/package (@rask/config). Matches lance-ns's @rask/config. Apps extend this + their .svelte-kit/tsconfig.json.
//noUncheckedIndexedAccess: ON estate-wide (#95): five zones had hand-inlined it while the two zones and six packages extending THIS file silently ran without it — an index into an array or record answers T | undefined everywhere now, not just where someone remembered.
//exactOptionalPropertyTypes: OFF here, deliberately (#95): Bits UI's builder prop unions explode under it ('union too complex to represent') in every Svelte-facing package, so the flag cannot ride the shared base. @rask/api opts into it in its OWN tsconfig — it is Svelte-free — and any other pure-TS package may do the same; do not 'fix' this by adding it here.
